technical_and_design_decisions: Implement each user story within the existing project architecture and public API conventions, minimizing unrelated refactoring.
Represent the Mesos undeployed state as a distinct SPI status and preserve existing handling of the unknown state for backward compatibility.
Expose RabbitBindingCleaner through the existing REST controller, routing, serialization, and error-handling conventions.
Optimize YARN deployment by reducing redundant deployment and module-processing operations while preserving deployment ordering, failure behavior, and externally visible semantics.
Upgrade SHDP to 2.2.1 GA and align Spring and Hadoop dependencies only as required by that release, avoiding the incompatible SHDP 2.3.0 and Boot 1.3 migration.
Upgrade Spring Integration to 4.2.2.GA using dependency-management conventions and verify compatibility with existing integration components.
Add Kafka bus partition-key configuration and apply it even when the bus has a single downstream module, while retaining existing behavior when no key is configured.
Upgrade Boot and Spring Cloud Build revisions through the project build and dependency-management files, retaining the currently supported Java and plugin conventions.
Document HSQL DB limitations for composed jobs in the existing project documentation location, including practical consequences and workarounds where known.
Use automated unit, integration, build, and regression tests as appropriate for each change, with a final full-build verification before delivery.
assumptions: The repository, build, and test infrastructure are available and can be run locally without environment provisioning effort.
The specification refers to an existing Spring XD or Spring Cloud Data Flow-era codebase with Mesos, Rabbit, YARN, Kafka, SHDP, and composed-job implementations already present.
Existing issue details, expected endpoint conventions, and dependency coordinates can be inferred from the codebase and current tests; no new external product design is required.
The YARN optimization requirement is limited to code-level performance improvements in the existing deployer and does not require a redesign of the YARN deployment protocol or cluster infrastructure.

Compatibility testing is performed against the existing supported test matrix and representative local or embedded dependencies; testing every external Hadoop, broker, and application-server distribution is out of scope.
No new UI is required for the Rabbit cleaner or Kafka partition-key functionality; configuration and REST API changes use existing mechanisms.
Documentation changes are limited to the HSQL DB composed-job limitation and related usage guidance.

Effort includes implementation, developer-authored tests, local troubleshooting, build-file updates, documentation, and final regression verification, but excludes elapsed waiting time and work by other people.
The estimates assume no substantial unrelated failures are discovered during the dependency upgrades.

activities.activity_description: Inspect the existing modules, build files, status models, REST conventions, deployers, binders, dependency management, and tests; identify affected components and establish the implementation and verification plan for all user stories.
Add the undeployed Mesos SPI status, update status mapping and lifecycle handling, preserve unknown-state behavior where applicable, and add focused unit and integration tests.

activities.activity_name: Expose Rabbit binding cleaner through REST
activities.activity_description: Connect RabbitBindingCleaner to the existing REST API, add request handling, validation, response and error behavior, wire the required application context components, and create controller and integration tests.

Profile or inspect current stream and module deployment paths, remove redundant operations and avoidable waits or lookups, preserve deployment semantics, and add performance-oriented and regression tests for stream and module deployment.

activities.activity_name: Upgrade SHDP, Spring, and Hadoop dependency baseline
activities.activity_description: Update dependency versions to SHDP 2.2.1 GA and the required newer Spring and Hadoop versions, resolve transitive conflicts, update affected APIs or configuration, and run compatibility and build tests without adopting SHDP 2.3.0.
Upgrade Spring Integration to 4.2.2.GA, adjust integration code or configuration for compatibility, and execute relevant unit, integration, and messaging regression tests.

Add configuration and propagation of a Kafka partitioning key for buses with a single downstream module, integrate it with native Kafka partition selection and ordering behavior, preserve existing multi-downstream behavior, and add focused tests.

activities.activity_name: Upgrade Boot and Spring Cloud Build revisions
activities.activity_description: Update Boot and Spring Cloud Build revision properties or parent configuration, resolve build-plugin and dependency-management impacts, and verify compilation, packaging, and representative application tests.

Investigate the relevant HSQL DB behavior, document limitations and affected composed-job scenarios in the project documentation, and add examples or workarounds where supported by the existing implementation.

Run the complete build and relevant test suites, validate dependency-upgrade interactions across binders and deployers, diagnose and fix regressions caused by the increment, and verify backward-compatible behavior.
Clean up implementation and tests, update release notes or change documentation as appropriate, verify source formatting and build reproducibility, and prepare the complete change set for delivery.
